name: ZF 8HP (first generation) EGS / TCU

read_methods.notes: Bench over CAN. MaxxECU documents reflashing Gen1 units with its own software; OEM OBD read/write capability is not documented in the cited sources.

notes: Eight-speed ZF automatic, TCU integrated in the gearbox. MaxxECU's table lists SH725xx processors for every supported unit and marks the '2048 KB memory area' units as unsupported; Gen2/Gen3 (TriCore) are different hardware. OpenTune's zf8hp checksum covers the AL551-generation CAL block (e.g. 4G0/4H1 software) and needs a stock reference dump to correct. Pin numbers are from the Dodge Gen1 connector per MaxxECU; confirm for other brands.

bench.notes: Main supply 13, wake-up 9, ground 14, CAN-H 5 / CAN-L 6. MaxxECU: apply the main supply for 10-15 s BEFORE the wake-up line, or part of the TCU does not initialise.
bench.resistor_notes: The 8HP TCU has NO internal termination (MaxxECU): fit 120 ohm at the TCU end in addition to the interface's own termination.

safety_note: Bench safety: use a current-limited bench supply (12-13.8 V, start with a low current limit) and a fuse in the +12 V lead; connect ground first. Confirm every pin with a multimeter on YOUR unit before applying power - ground pins should show continuity to each other (and usually the housing), and hardware revisions can differ from the sources. A CAN bus needs about 60 ohm between CAN-H and CAN-L (two 120 ohm terminations): add a 120 ohm resistor if neither the unit nor your interface terminates. Swapped CAN-H/CAN-L just gives timeouts; +12 V on a signal pin can destroy the unit.

sources.title: MaxxECU: advanced 8HP installation and wiring (CPU / supported units)
